summary: End-to-end validation of new User Management (CRUD + reset-password) and Visual Workflow Builder modules. Backend: 28/28 pytest passed (auth regression, supervisor RBAC, duplicate email, invalid role, deactivate -> login blocked, password reset old/new, self-delete blocked, seeded workflows present, custom create/update/delete, soft-disable for seed, KB + analyze regression). Frontend: demo@flowpilot.ai login, sidebar shows Users + Workflows, Workflows page renders 5 seed cards + pipeline diagram, create/edit/delete custom workflow works, Users page lists 7 users, create/edit/reset-password/delete via UI all working, self-delete button correctly hidden for own row.
action_items: (Optional) Spec mentions 'admin' role but backend only accepts agent/supervisor (request body) and require_supervisor() only allows role=='supervisor'. Either expand role enum to include 'admin' or update the original problem statement / docs to state only two roles exist. Currently any 'admin' attempt returns 400.

(Optional) Original review_request misc text mentions seed workflows like 'Refund Request' / 'Account Update'; actual seeds are kyc/loan/claims/retention/general. Either update SEED_WORKFLOWS or update the doc to match.

(Optional) WorkflowBuilder.jsx remove button uses window.confirm (browser native) instead of shadcn AlertDialog; UserManagement.jsx delete also uses window.confirm. Consider replacing for consistent design.
(Optional) update_user PATCH does not allow updating email; intentional per current design but worth documenting.
(Optional) /api/workflows is readable by any authenticated user (correct), but /api/workflows/{id} GET also requires auth only — agents can read. PATCH/POST/DELETE are correctly supervisor-gated.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~927 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Strongly recommend splitting into routers: routers/auth.py, routers/users.py, routers/workflows.py, routers/calls.py, routers/kb.py, routers/integrations.py.
create_workflow slug collision handling (`wid + '-' + uuid[:6]`) is fine but two custom workflows with same name will get different ids — acceptable but worth a unit test.

delete_seed_workflow soft-disables but there is no UI affordance to re-activate a deactivated seed (seed cards filtered by active=true in list). Supervisors would have to GET by id manually. Consider an 'inactive' tab.

PasswordResetReq enforces min length 6 server-side; UserManagement.jsx also enforces 6 client-side — consistent. However register/create-user does NOT enforce min length on backend, only via Pydantic EmailStr — short passwords currently allowed at create. Consider adding min_length=6 to UserCreateReq.password.
require_supervisor uses string check; if role taxonomy ever expands, add a roles set constant.
Auto-seeding inside GET /workflows works but creates a tiny race (two simultaneous first-time GETs could double-seed); fine for MVP but consider an idempotent upsert by id.
seed_data_creation: Test users (test_uiuser_beta@flowpilot.ai, test_cu_*) created and cleaned up. Test workflow 'TEST_UI Refund Flow' created and deleted. Seed workflow 'general' was soft-disabled then re-activated by the test suite to leave seed data clean.
